name: pdk-dbt-mntn-dbt
instr:
Since MNTN changed its metadata tables, they only get a row when something about a creative, ad tag, account or segment changes, and our reports in /app went bad. Most days in mntn__ad_report have no click URL, ad code or tag status, account_time_zone and the segment descriptions are mostly empty, mntn__url_report only has rows for the days a change came in, and some daily totals are too high. A sample of the sync from August 15 to the end of September is in /data/mntn/, laid out like the seeds in /app/integration_tests/seeds.

Every report row should show each metadata value as it stood at the end of that day, which is what the latest change on or before that day set it to. A value is NULL only before the first change that gives it one, and rows MNTN deleted don't count. mntn__url_report should have a row for each ad and day that has a click URL in effect, with base_url and the UTM columns taken from that URL. Every report keeps one row per ad, account, segment, campaign, ad group, country or region and day, with that day's metrics as MNTN last sent them.

We run it from /app/integration_tests with dbt seed and then dbt build, which has to pass with the existing data tests, and a rebuild after more rows arrive has to match a fresh build. The change stays in SQL models, macros and YAML, with no Python models. Could you find what's going wrong and fix it? There's no network, and dbt-duckdb is installed.
